name: Market Analysis
description: Analyze an asset across structure, liquidity, catalysts, timeframe alignment, and no-trade conditions.
purpose: Give ZAR a repeatable process for evaluating stocks, ETFs, options, futures, crypto, and forex without placing trades.

stages.name: Market Selection
stages.description: Identify the asset, market, timeframe, and analysis objective.

steps.label: Capture symbol, asset class, timeframe, and market session context.
Check known catalysts such as earnings, CPI, FOMC, major news, or market-wide events.

stages.name: Technical Read
stages.description: Evaluate structure, liquidity, supply/demand, and multi-timeframe alignment.

steps.label: Document trend, range, BOS, CHOCH, support, resistance, supply, and demand.
Identify liquidity pools, sweeps, equal highs/lows, and stop-hunt risks.
Rank the setup as watch, observe, possible setup, valid setup, or no trade.

userFacingBlurb: Analyze an asset before deciding whether a thesis is justified.
